_doc: The mood line at the top of the play screen: never facts, never the time — a feeling that foreshadows. Picked each played day by priority: what's coming in your own story (fated turning points, arc steps), then pending life events, then your situation, then this year's 사주/점성술 signals. Lines may be limited to an MBTI letter ('mbti': 'E' / 'I' / 'F' / 'T' / 'N' / 'S' / 'J' / 'P'). {spouse} = 남편/아내/애인.
